title: decision
description: One dated decision by the person who holds the mandate. It is the source of every commitment and every intent; it is never a fact about the world. A decision without what would reopen it is a preference.

decision.description: what is decided, as one sentence that stands on its own

question.description: the question it answers, when the answer alone does not carry it

by.description: the person who holds the mandate

executed_by.description: who carries it out, when not the same

binds.description: where it binds: the terms, schemas, extensions or commons it governs

why.description: the reasoning, in the words of the one who decided where possible

reopens_if.description: the condition that reopens it; not a date, not a mood

amends.description: decisions it narrows or extends; they stay in force

supersedes.description: decisions it replaces; they stay on record as superseded

where.description: where it was taken: an issue, a conversation, a meeting

status.description: a superseded or reopened decision is a new record's doing, never an edit of this one's substance

examples.decision: World replaces Game: a world names a full future state and its moves, and never binds a role, a budget or a person.
examples.binds: the term world, the instance type .w, every commons that models futures
examples.why: A pole of the future is a state, not a rule set.
examples.reopens_if: a future state appears that cannot be modelled without binding a role, a budget or a person
